title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1978-10-21
lineage: Nakamichi CR3A w/ Dolby > Audigy 4 Pro @ 24/44.1 > Editing with NERO > Tracked With CD Wave > Dithered to 16 bit with Audacity > Flac (level 8)
source: Recorded by: Mike Martin and Mark Bunton. Our location was on the floor under the mirrored ball about 20-25 feet from the stage dead center. Equipment: 2 Sony ecm-280 microphones (shoulder high) > Teac PC-10 w/ Dolby > TDK SA-C90 tape.

ai_review.summary: Excellent, low‑hiss audience recording of a legendary Winterland show, though specific musical details are scarce.
ai_review.review: The second review praises the tape for its clear, low‑hiss sound and solid levels, calling it the best source for this “monster” Winterland performance. The first review is an anecdotal recollection that adds historical flavor but offers no concrete evaluation of the music or recording quality.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic five‑star review highlights superb audio quality, while the other provides only a personal narrative; lack of detailed musical commentary limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low hiss, good overall levels, clear and balanced sound; noted as better than the Holwein audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific song or set‑flow comments were provided in the reviews.
